rules.statement: Administrative authorities must follow a statutory procedure when canceling a lease permit or instrument of disposition.
rules.supporting_quote: An examination of the provisions referred to above would make it clear that before a cancellation of a lease permit or an instrument of disposition, a particular procedure has been clearly laid down in sections 106-128 of the Land Development Ordinance.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: sections 106-128 of the Land Development Ordinance
